_comment: zero-slop pattern database. Each pattern: name, cat(egory), rx (Python regex, case-insensitive), w (weight ~ how damning one hit is). Lexicon: LLM-overrepresented terms -> per-hit weight (matched as word prefix). learned.json merges over this at runtime.

patterns.name: conclusion-scaffold
patterns.rx: \b(?:in conclusion|in summary|to sum up|ultimately, |overall, |the key takeaway|at the end of the day)\b

patterns.name: meta-commentary
patterns.rx: \b(?:let me (?:walk you through|break (?:this|it) down|explain)|in this (?:article|post|piece), (?:we|i)(?:'ll| will)|let(?:'|’)s (?:dive|unpack|explore|take a closer look))\b

patterns.name: so-you-dont-have-to
patterns.rx: \bso you don(?:'|’)t have to\b|\bfind out the hard way\b|\bskip (?:that|the) (?:part|pain|struggle)\b

patterns.name: spirit-of-transparency
patterns.rx: \bin the spirit of (?:transparency|openness)\b|\ba significant portion of\b|\bthe short version is\b

patterns.name: emotional-labor
patterns.rx: \b(?:hardest (?:decision|thing) (?:of|i)|poured (?:everything|our hearts?)|i owe it to|writing this (?:post|is)n?(?:'|’)?t? ?(?:is )?(?:painful|hard)|with a heavy heart)\b

patterns.name: aphorism-formula
patterns.rx: \b\w+ isn(?:'|’)t the opposite of \w+\b|\bisn(?:'|’)t (?:a|the) (?:destination|sprint)[,.;] (?:it|but)\b|\bit(?:'|’)s a marathon\b

patterns.name: manufactured-stakes
patterns.rx: \bin today(?:'|’)s (?:fast-paced|rapidly (?:evolving|changing)|digital|competitive|ever-changing|modern)\b|\bnow more than ever\b|\bthe stakes have never been higher\b|\bin an era (?:of|where)\b|\bin the age of\b

patterns.name: performed-candor
patterns.rx: \b(?:let(?:'|’)s be (?:honest|real|clear)|here(?:'|’)s the (?:thing|truth|kicker)|i(?:'|’)ll be honest|the (?:uncomfortable|hard) truth is|truth be told|no fluff|real talk)\b

patterns.name: faux-insight
patterns.rx: \b(?:what (?:most people|nobody) (?:get(?:s)? wrong|tells you|misses)|the part everyone misses|most people (?:don't|won't|never) (?:realize|see|notice)|here(?:'|’)s what (?:i|we) learned)\b

patterns.name: rhetorical-opener
patterns.rx: \b(?:ever wondered|what if i told you|have you ever (?:wondered|noticed|felt))\b|\bplot twist:

patterns.name: read-again
patterns.rx: \b(?:read that again|let that sink in|sit with that|i(?:'|’)ll wait)\b

patterns.name: puffery-testament
patterns.rx: \b(?:stands? as a testament|serves? as a (?:testament|reminder)|is a testament to|marks? a pivotal|pivotal moment|plays? a (?:vital|crucial|key|significant) role|solidif(?:y|ies) (?:its|their)|underscor(?:es|ing) (?:its|the)|cements? (?:its|their) (?:position|place|status))\b

patterns.name: future-is
patterns.rx: \bthe future (?:of \w+ )?is (?:here|now|bright)\b|\bwe(?:'|’)re just getting started\b|\bfuture you will thank you\b|\bstay tuned\b

patterns.name: engagement-bait
patterns.rx: \b(?:agree\?|thoughts\?|what(?:'|’)s your (?:take|experience)|drop a comment|let me know in the comments|share this with|tag someone|repost if|follow (?:me|for more))\b

patterns.name: journey-gratitude
patterns.rx: \b(?:this journey|the journey (?:so far|ahead)|grateful (?:for|to)|couldn(?:'|’)t have done it without|huge (?:thanks|shout.?out)|humbled and)\b

patterns.name: emphasis-crutch
patterns.rx: \b(?:make no mistake|make it count|and (?:honestly|frankly)\?|the result\?|the outcome\?|spoiler(?: alert)?:)

patterns.name: weak-verb-phrase
patterns.rx: \b(?:has the ability to|is able to|in order to|made the decision to|conduct(?:ed)? an analysis)\b

patterns.name: assistant-voice
patterns.rx: \b(?:great question|i(?:'|’)d be happy to|i hope this (?:helps|email finds you well)|certainly!|absolutely!|without further ado|buckle up)\b
